title: incident-bot: oncall diagnostics autosuggestions and runbook ranking
author: Maya Patel
description:
Summary:
Add autosuggestion ranking for runbook links and on-call diagnostics hints in incident-bot. This change introduces a lightweight ML-backed ranking layer (served as a feature flag) and deterministic heuristics fallback. Motivation:
On recent incidents the on-call flow surfaced too many runbook links and too little signal for the appropriate next steps. SREs requested prioritized suggestions based on SLO context, recent runbook usage, and similarity to the active incident title/summary. Changes:
- Introduce suggestions/ranking API and controller (incident_bot.suggestions)
- Add a small candidate scoring service that combines signal features: SLO match, runbook frequency (team), TF-IDF similarity on titles, and recent on-call feedback.
- Integrate with the existing runbook db and on-call context extractor
- Add feature flag (ff_incident_suggestions) and rollout config in infra/flags.yaml
- Update IncidentBot UI to display top-3 suggestions with confidence scores and quick-link buttons
- Add telemetry and new metrics: suggestions.request_count, suggestions.hits, suggestions.latency_ms, suggestions.feedback_rate
- Docs: update runbook authoring guidance and on-call playbook to include suggestion opt-outs
Testing:
- Unit tests for scoring heuristics and ranking determinism
- Integration tests that simulate SLO-linked incidents and ensure top candidates contain SLO-runbooks
- End-to-end staging test against a snapshot of runbook DB (flag off by default)
Rollout:
- Feature-flagged rollout with gradual ramp: 0% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% over two weeks; safe-mode fallback to deterministic heuristics if scoring service fails or latency > 200ms
Related:
- Linear: ENG-2345 (oncall diagnostics), ENG-2410 (runbook ranking)

review_comments:
Alyssa Chen: Please add a fallback timeout for scorer calls so we don't block oncall flows. Suggested 150ms.
Maya Patel: Added timeout + unit tests to enforce behavior.

Diego Morales: Can we avoid a cold-start perf hit when caching runbook embeddings? Consider a background prewarm job.
Maya Patel: Implemented a prewarm hook that runs at rollout; documented the requirement and added a health endpoint for prewarm status.

Samir Gupta: LGTm, one minor nit: tighten the logging around failed scoring to avoid PII.
Maya Patel: Removed user-provided content from logs, added structured error tags.

Diego Morales (requested changes): Add explicit quota and circuit-breaker config for the scorer to protect control plane.
Maya Patel: Added circuit-breaker with default thresholds and wrote integration test that simulates high error-rate scenario.
Alyssa Chen: Verified metrics look good in staging and latency stays under 80ms for cached queries.
Samir Gupta: Approved after tests and docs updates.
release_notes: incident-bot: on-call diagnostics now surfaces ranked runbook suggestions. Feature gated behind ff_incident_suggestions. Rollout gradual; safe fallback to heuristics on errors.
notes_for_oncall: Flag ff_incident_suggestions is off in prod by default. If turned on and you see elevated errors for incident-bot.suggestions.* metrics, flip flag off and revert scorer via /ops/feature-flags. Use suggestions.feedback_rate metric to measure usefulness.
acknowledgements: Thanks to SRE/Oncall for feedback and QA: Jamie Liu, Rafael Ortega, Priya Nair
